claims.quote: Heterozygous de novo and inherited biallelic pathogenic variants in DNM1 have been reported in association with autosomal dominant (AD) and autosomal recessive (AR) developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, respectively
due to aberrant dynamin function or expression
the de novo dominant negative-associated c.194C>A (p.Thr65Asn)
the maternally inherited loss of function-associated c.850C>T (p.Gln284*)
